newsitem.title: USA: IBM may enter Mac notebook mkt - CPM Media.
newsitem.headline: IBM may enter Mac notebook mkt - CPM Media.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp could enter the $1 billion Macintosh-compatible laptop market with a high-powered system that will run Apple Computer Inc's operating system but bear IBM's logo, CMP Media Inc said.

The laptop would use IBM technology and the newest release of MacOS running on the 240 MHz PowerPC 603e that powers Apple's new PowerBook3400 series or a faster version now under development, CMP said, citing a source close to the project.
The market for MacOS laptops was set for picking, James Staten, an analyst for Dataquest in San Jose, Calif., told CMP's TechWire.
"IBM could easily take 30 to 40 percent of market share away from Apple because Apple can't meet the demand," Staten was quoted as saying. "This is a prime time to do it."
IBM was not immediately available to comment.
CMP Media provides publishing, marketing and information services to those involved in the high-technology market.
